item.title: ILLIT to perform opening theme for new Japanese anime
item.description: Girl group ILLIT will perform the opening theme for a new Japanese television anime series, the group’s agency, Belift Lab, announced Tuesday. The quintet will provide the song “Bubee” for the anime Mahou no Shimai Lulutto Lilly (Magical Sisters Lulutto Lilly), which is set to premiere in April. “Bubee” is described as a dance-pop track with a J-pop foundation and a “Shibuya-kei” subculture sensibility.
